features.name: Agent creation and configuration
features.description: Users can create agent instances by clicking an agent button, defining instance names, descriptions, and configuring language and region settings to control how the agent operates in different locales and time zones.

features.name: Manage user access for agents
features.description: Agents can be shared with other users with configurable permissions. Users can be granted the ability to assign tasks to an agent or to configure the agent and assign additional users.

features.name: Profiles and permissions configuration
features.description: Users must configure profiles and permissions to control what data agents can see and what actions they can perform. These settings require iterative re-evaluation as agents mature to ensure appropriate access levels.
caveats: Requires careful iteration to avoid over-granting permissions

features.name: Agent instructions configuration
features.description: Users can define and iteratively refine agent instructions that specify guidelines and purpose. Instructions can be created, tweaked, and improved over time using prompting best practices and with assistance from Copilots or other agents.

features.name: Agent model selection
features.description: Users can choose between different AI models for their agents, including GPT-4 and GPT-4.1, with a newer GPT-5 option available. Model selection is presented as a dropdown in version 28 and allows users to optimize for cost and capability.

features.name: Agent task simulation and testing
features.description: Users can test agents by creating task simulations that replicate incoming signals. For email-based tasks, users specify subject, from address, message, and attachments. Task details depend on the scenario and business process events the agent should respond to.
caveats: Task construction depends on the specific scenario and triggering signal

features.name: Task templates
features.description: Users can create and reuse task templates that quickly generate test tasks with predefined parameters. This allows rapid iteration of agent testing by changing parameters and re-running tasks multiple times.

features.name: Task log and execution tracking
features.description: The task log displays all iterations of test tasks and allows navigation between different task runs. Users can view detailed step-by-step information about agent actions, including what the agent saw, tools it used, and decisions it made.

features.name: Agent tools and capabilities
features.description: Agents have access to tools that define what actions they can perform, such as navigate. The tools are displayed during task execution and help the agent determine available actions based on its profile and permissions.

features.name: User intervention in agent workflows
features.description: Agents can request user intervention when they need feedback or approval. The task log shows user intervention steps with access to relevant documents and attachments that the agent created for user review.

features.name: Download agent instructions
features.description: Users can download just the agent instructions to include in an extension they want to ship as part of their solution.

features.name: Export agent definition
features.description: Users can export complete agent definitions from the agents list, which collects all configuration information including profile, permissions, instructions, locale, and version details. This enables sharing and deployment of agent configurations.

features.name: Production agent deployment via extensions
features.description: From version 2008 onwards, agents can be run in production environments by creating an extension and publishing it to production. Agents created with instructions in the client cannot run in production; they must be packaged as extensions.
caveats: Agents with instructions in client cannot run in production
Extension must be published to production environment

features.name: Agent template for AL projects
features.description: A project template available through the new project command that provides a complete scaffold including instructions, configuration, files, and documentation for developing agents. The template includes a readme file explaining implementation details and file organization.

features.name: Copilot capability feature gate
features.description: Copilot capabilities act as feature gates for agents. Disabling a copilot capability deactivates all agent instances using that capability, making them completely unavailable to users. Re-enabling the capability restores agent availability.

features.name: Agent metadata provider enumeration
features.description: Core enumeration interface that tells the platform about agents, how to create them, and how tasks are executed. Enables the platform to understand agent capabilities and behavior.

features.name: Agent factory interface
features.description: Interface that allows creation of agent instances and linking to copilot capabilities. Includes Show Can Create Agent method to determine visibility and discoverability of agents to users based on custom logic like role or existing instances.

features.name: Agent metadata interface for runtime configuration
features.description: Configures runtime behavior of agent instances including display settings, initials, custom setup pages, and optional summary card page ID to show agent processing status and customer value.

features.name: Take agent task execution interface
features.description: Optional interface for intercepting and managing task execution flow. Allows custom logic to run as the agent processes tasks.

features.name: Optional interface methods
features.description: New AL language feature allowing default implementations and optional methods in interfaces. Enables selective implementation of interface methods, making only required methods mandatory.

features.name: Complex agent scenarios with user intervention
features.description: Support for realistic agent workflows requiring multiple steps including verification of original invoices, resolution checks, credit memo creation, user approval requests, and feedback loops for continuous refinement.

features.name: AI evaluation tools for agents
features.description: Testing framework that allows running tests using own data sets to measure accuracy and relevance of agents. Can be integrated with CI/CD pipelines to track quality over time and detect regressions. Available in sandbox only for testing before production deployment.
caveats: Testing tool meant to be run before going to production

features.name: Copilot credit consumption visibility in tests
features.description: Explicit showing of Copilot credit cost for executing tasks in test execution. Shows total tokens consumed by test framework, including LLM-as-judge calls if used for quality assessment.
caveats: Does not show actual tokens consumed by agents themselves, only test framework tokens

features.name: Agent instance experimentation
features.description: Ability to publish the same agent multiple times with different models and instructions, then change them one at a time to determine which configuration works best for a scenario.

features.name: AI evals suite page
features.description: Generic tooling for running AI tests. Supports multiple eval types including Copilot, agent, and MCP. Displays test results grouped by scenarios with execution metrics.

features.name: Budget controls for agent tests
features.description: Two-level limit system for controlling Copilot credit spending. Environment-level limit applies across all companies, and company-level limit per company. Prevents execution of new tasks when limits are reached but allows running tasks to complete.
caveats: Limits prevent new task execution but do not stop in-progress tasks
May result in going slightly over budget due to incomplete task execution

features.name: Agent task drill-down and troubleshooting
features.description: Detailed view of individual test execution with error messages, stack traces, inputs, outputs in JSON format, and link to full agent tasks page for deeper troubleshooting of tool usage and agent behavior.

features.name: Copilot credit consumption visibility for non-admins
features.description: Changed from admin-only functionality to allow users with access to specific agents to see credit consumption for those agents only. Full overview remains admin-only.
caveats: Only agent admin can see full overview of all agents

features.name: Test run history and trend tracking
features.description: History view showing previous test runs with accuracy metrics and Copilot credit consumption over time, enabling tracking of trends and improvements.

features.name: Turn-based test design pattern
features.description: Test architecture where each agent input starts a new turn. Test design involves setting up turn data, executing agent processing, verifying outcome, then deciding to continue or stop before final turn completion.

features.name: AI development toolkit evaluation extension
features.description: Extension that bundles test code units, data sets, and config files. Propagates dependencies on AI test toolkit and agent test library, providing utilities for creating turns, executing them, and handling intervention requests.

features.name: Agent test library
features.description: New library app providing utilities for creating turns and executing them, handling intervention requests, and other capabilities needed for writing agent tests.

features.name: Data-driven agent test approach
features.description: Agent tests use data sets containing turn definitions for agent inputs and expected data for what agents should create or perform. Configuration files bundle data sets with code units for execution.

features.name: AI test suite XML configuration standard
features.description: XML-based well-known standard for defining AI test suites with one-to-one mapping to AI eval suite. Includes code, description, frequency, test type, and connections between code units and data sets.

features.name: AI test type code unit
features.description: Test code unit using new test type property set to AI test. Uses initialize method for setup and calls agent test context to retrieve user security ID of the test agent instance.

features.name: AI test type property
features.description: A new property for code units that defines the test type as AI test, enabling agent testing capabilities within the test framework.

features.name: Agent test context code unit
features.description: A library code unit that provides context about the current test being executed, including methods to get agent user security ID and interact with YAML-defined data sets.

features.name: YAML-based test data sets
features.description: Test data configured in YAML files containing suite setup actions with free-format key-value pairs that can be referenced in AL code through the AI test context library.
caveats: Configuration moves from AL code into data sets

features.name: Run turn and wait method
features.description: A library method in the agent code unit that executes turns for agent testing, creating tasks for the agent and running until the agent completes the turn.

features.name: Data-driven agent test framework
features.description: A complete framework for creating parameterized agent tests using data sets, enabling multiple test scenarios with shared test code and configuration-driven test variations.

features.name: Agent debugging with break on next
features.description: Debug tooling that allows stepping through agent execution using break on next and specific launch configuration, requiring the user ID from the agent list page.
caveats: Requires agent user ID from agent list page
